summary: This table presents the quarterly financial performance across various sectors for the period ending September 30, 2025, alongside comparisons to previous quarters. The sectors include Financial Services, Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services, Retail, Communication, Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, and Others. The table shows the percentage contributions of each sector for the quarters ending June 30, 2025, and September 30, 2024, as well as year-over-year growth rates. Notably, Financial Services leads with a contribution of 27.7% and a reported growth of 5.6%. The overall year-over-year growth for all sectors combined is reported at 3.7%. Trends indicate varying performance across sectors, with Manufacturing and Communication showing significant growth rates of 9.3% and 5.7%, respectively.
